name: chart_generate
label: 生成统计图
description: Render a polished ECharts chart (any chart type); the frontend renders it. Requirements: concise title; meaningful category/stage and series names; a chart type that fits the data (funnel for stages, pie for share, line for trends, bar for comparison); complete legend, tooltip, data labels and axis names; numbers formatted with thousand separators or percentages; harmonious colors; real data only, never empty series. A full option object gives the most control; otherwise pass type/title/categories/series and let the tool assemble it.

option.description: full ECharts option (any chart type): include title/tooltip/legend/series, colors via a color array, numbers via formatter; use either this or type/categories/series

type.description: chart type (bar/line/pie/funnel/radar, ...); optional when option is given

categories.description: category or stage names (e.g. date/vehicle model/intent)

series.description: data series; multiple series can be compared
